contract.verify_command: pwsh -NoLogo -NoProfile -Command "pwsh -NoLogo -NoProfile -File work/20260924-1815-Gate2-TerminalState-check.ps1; if ($LASTEXITCODE) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }; $a = @(Get-Content work/20260924-1815-Gate2-TerminalState.md -TotalCount 2 -Encoding utf8); $b = @(Get-Content work/20260924-1815-Gate2-AtgReport.md -TotalCount 2 -Encoding utf8); if ($a[0] -cne '主 run: 静止（失敗あり）' -or $a[1] -cne 'G2A-03: not-done' -or $b[0] -cne '# ATG 終端レポート') { exit 1 }; if (-not (Select-String -Path work/20260924-1815-Gate2Final2-G2F-00-Review.md -Pattern '^blocking: 0$' -Quiet)) { exit 1 }"
